summary: Approved as a compatibility-only extension of the locked OncoReady staff case workspace: one Insights tab presents validated offline synthetic-model outputs, honest evidence and limitations, checkpoint-specific factors, and an isolated transportation sensitivity comparison without mutating workflow state or implying clinical inference.

notes_for_frontend: Implement the exact design report committed at 68f1778ac47d7d49a47a7a7f31c6573deeca3680 and preserve every existing global token, component style, shell behavior, theme, and non-ML case tab.

Treat ml/artifacts/demo-insights.json as canonical and fail closed at the typed frontend boundary. No runtime inference, arbitrary input, workflow dispatch, score-driven clinical action, or fabricated fallback value is allowed.

Keep checkpoint, disclosure, and what-if selection local to the Insights component. Verify semantic tab/disclosure/comparison keyboard behavior, readable factor labels, evidence links, reduced motion, invalid/missing artifact states, and byte-for-byte workflow-state isolation.
Capture matched 1440x900 and 390x844 result screenshots against the committed baselines; unapproved visual drift is a blocker.
